AtomicSystem#

class AtomicSystem(topology)[source]#

Bases: EditMixin, IOMixin, TopologyMixin, ForceFieldMixin

Container storing the complete atomic system representation.

The class stores atomic coordinates, topology information (bonds, angles, dihedrals and impropers), simulation box parameters, atomic masses and charges, and force field parameters.

It is designed to represent the content of a LAMMPS data file and provides utilities for editing, analysing and exporting atomistic systems.

Parameters:
topologydict[str, Any]

Dictionary containing the complete system data.

Required keys:
  • coordinatesnp.ndarray

    Atomic coordinates (N, 3)

  • boxnp.ndarray

    Simulation box dimensions (3,)

  • atom_typeslist or np.ndarray

    Atom type indices

  • masseslist or np.ndarray

    Atomic masses

  • chargeslist or np.ndarray

    Atomic charges

Optional keys:
  • bondsnp.ndarray

    Bond connectivity (N_bonds, 2)

  • anglesnp.ndarray

    Angle connectivity (N_angles, 3)

  • dihedralsnp.ndarray

    Dihedral connectivity (N_dihedrals, 4)

  • impropersnp.ndarray

    Improper connectivity (N_impropers, 4)

  • velocitiesnp.ndarray

    Atomic velocities (N, 3)

  • bond_paramsdict

    Bond force field parameters

  • angle_paramsdict

    Angle force field parameters

  • dihedral_paramsdict

    Dihedral force field parameters

  • improper_paramsdict

    Improper force field parameters

Topology#

AtomicSystem.set_types

Assign types to atoms, supporting both full lists and partial dictionaries.

AtomicSystem.set_type2atoms

Assign a new type to a specific subset of atoms.

AtomicSystem.set_types_from_elements

Reset atom types to their corresponding chemical elements.

AtomicSystem.set_topology

Apply a predefined style or custom rule(s) to the system.

AtomicSystem.remove_connection_types

Remove specific connection types from the system.

AtomicSystem.keep_connection_types

Keep only the specified connection types and remove all others.

AtomicSystem.guess_connections

Guess angles, dihedrals and/or impropers directly from existing bonds.

AtomicSystem.guess_angles

Guess only angles from existing bonds.

AtomicSystem.guess_dihedrals

Guess only dihedrals from existing bonds.

AtomicSystem.guess_impropers

Guess only impropers from existing bonds.

AtomicSystem.add_bond

Set a bond between two atoms.

AtomicSystem.add_angle

Set a angle between two atoms.

AtomicSystem.add_dihedral

Set a dihedral between two atoms.

AtomicSystem.add_improper

Set a improper between two atoms.

Force Field#

AtomicSystem.set_masses

Set the masses for the atomic system.

AtomicSystem.set_charges

Set or update the charges for the atomic system and the atoms DataFrame.

AtomicSystem.set_ff_from_database

Apply force field parameters from the TOML database.

AtomicSystem.explore_ff_database

Interactive Forcefield Explorer using the prompt_toolkit UI pattern.

AtomicSystem.set_pair_params

Assign non-bond parameters for a pair of atom types (self or cross).

AtomicSystem.set_bond_params

Assign structural parameters for a specific bond type.

AtomicSystem.set_angle_params

Assign structural parameters for a specific angle type.

AtomicSystem.apply_pair_mixing_rules

Calculate and update cross-interaction parameters (i != j).

Modifiers#

AtomicSystem.add_structure

Add a structure on top of this system.

AtomicSystem.add_liquid_layer

Add a liquid layer on top of this system.

AtomicSystem.add_droplet

Add a hemispherical liquid droplet on top of this system.

AtomicSystem.add_atom

Add a single atom.

AtomicSystem.add_atoms

Add multiple atoms to the system in a single operation.

AtomicSystem.protonate_atom

Add a proton to a single atom.

AtomicSystem.protonate_atoms

Add protons to multiple atoms in a single operation.

AtomicSystem.remove_atom

Remove a single atom.

AtomicSystem.remove_atoms

Remove the specified atoms and update connectivity accordingly.

AtomicSystem.set_atom_position

Modify the coordinates of a single atom using a vector (x, y, z).

AtomicSystem.set_box

Assign a new box to the system and compute all representations.

AtomicSystem.orthogonalize

Attempt to transform a triclinic (skewed) box into an orthogonal one.

AtomicSystem.unskew

Unskew the box if the non-diagonal parameters of the box matrix \(|H_{i,j}| > H_{j,j}\) for \(i \neq j\) by adding \(\pm H_{j,:}\) to \(H_{i,:}\) while \(|H_{i,j}| > H_{j,j}\).

AtomicSystem.replicate

Replicate the system by integer factors along the lattice vectors (a, b, c).

AtomicSystem.wrap

Wraps all atoms back into the simulation box [0, L] using Periodic Boundary Conditions.

AtomicSystem.center_on_com

Translates the system so its center of mass is at the center of the box.
